title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Merge duplicate records (customers, vendors, or contacts)
summary: The Merge Duplicate feature in Business Central allows users to consolidate duplicate customer, vendor, or contact records by selecting which field values to keep and resolving any conflicts before completing the merge. This standard feature helps maintain data quality when records are created during data entry or migration.
key_points: Access the Merge Duplicate feature from the card of the record you want to keep using the Merge With action
The Fields FastTab displays differences between two records; few differences indicate a likely duplicate
The Related Tables FastTab shows connections to other tables and helps identify merge conflicts with primary key fields
Users can override field values by checking the Override checkbox to select which alternate values to keep
Merge conflicts can be resolved on the Merge Duplicate Conflicts page before finalizing the merge, with options to remove or rename the duplicate record

quotes.text: Only users with the MERGE DUPLICATES permission set can use this functionality.
quotes.why_it_matters: Important security and access control requirement
